name: 海洋2002
english_description: The in-game title is Ocean II, and it's a follow-on, evolved version of this project's hy2000 -- the two share 10,630 of 10,632 files by path, with hy2002 adding roughly 3,000 new files on top (new maps, new sect content) over the same marriage-system/sect-map base (d/marry/, d/happy/, Huashan/Wudang/Shaolin/Beggars'-Sect). It carries the same "Ocean/hy" security-daemon-backdoor admin scheme as hy2000, but here the hardcoded backdoor id ("hxsd") turned out to already belong to a real, unrecoverable old player account, forcing a side-by-side admin grant instead of a direct claim. A real anti-abuse rule caps new registrations to one per IP per 60 seconds -- by design, not a bug. New characters progress from registration through the newbie sequence, exploring and leaving Ping'an City, a fight, death, and Ghost-Gate revival.
